```sql
SELECT p.poi_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, ST_Centroid(pr.geometry::geography)) AS distance_meters
FROM pois p
JOIN regions r ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)
JOIN parks pr ON ST_Intersects(pr.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)
WHERE p.tourism = 'attraction'
  AND r.region_name ILIKE '%Phoenix%'
  AND r.border_type = 'city'
  AND ST_Area(pr.geometry::geography) > 10000
ORDER BY p.geometry::geography <-> ST_Centroid(pr.geometry::geography)
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT p.park_name, ST_Distance(p.geometry::geography, m.geometry::geography) AS distance_meters
FROM parks p
JOIN (
    SELECT pois.geometry
    FROM pois
    JOIN regions r ON ST_Intersects(pois.geometry::geography, r.geometry::geography)
    WHERE pois.poi_name ILIKE '%museum%'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM regions
          WHERE wikidata IS NOT NULL
            AND region_name ILIKE '%Arlington, MA%'
            AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW()) + 1830 = 1830
      )
) m ON ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, m.geometry::geography, 1000)
ORDER BY p.geometry <-> m.geometry
LIMIT 1;
```
